title: 第4章 神鬼降临
content_zh:
“驴哥，这小子进去不到五分钟就又出来了，他到底在搞什么？难道是去报警了？”黑色商务车上，开车的彪子看着不紧不慢离开大楼的楚岩，脑袋里的细胞开始大面积的死亡，以他的智商，实在猜测不出楚岩跑去那个所有混混最不愿意去的地方干什么去了。

“管那么多干什么，走跟上去，把开哥交代的事情搞定。”野驴明显是这群混混的头，满脑子里全都是些乌漆麻黑的想法，现在的他，只想着完成罗开交代的任务之后的事情，女人、毒品、酒精，这些东西充斥在野驴每天的生活里。

“恩，走。”彪子点点头，也就不在去想楚岩到底去那楼里干什么了，发动了车子缓缓朝着楚岩的身后接近着。

车上，总计坐着十三个人，把车内塞的满满的，这些人都是跟野驴的小弟，每天的工作就是打架、恐吓、收保护费，在南山市的西九城区也算是有些小名号，当然，仅限于底层混混的等级。

黑色商务车距离楚岩的距离越来越近，而楚岩依旧是不紧不慢的踱着步子，远处，是一条小巷，巷子里面的路灯只剩下三两盏在那吱吱啦啦的忽明忽暗。

忽然，商务车骤然加快了速度，彪子的脚狠狠的踩在油门上，商务车如同脱缰野马一般直奔楚岩冲了过去！

“吱！！”一声刺耳的刹车在夜空里格外令人毛骨悚然，远处，更是有几家原本还亮着灯的房间干脆的关了灯，这个年头，谁也不想在这大半夜的去凑什么热闹，一不小心就会惹祸上身。

“撞上了吗？”野驴第一个打开车门冲了下去，其余的混混紧随其后，这种事情他们不是第一次做，轻车熟路根本不担心会把人撞死，他们只是混混，还没到有胆子杀人的级别，但是把个把人弄成残废这种事他们可是不知干了多少次了。

“驴哥，好...好像没撞上...”彪子是最后一个下车的，因为他是司机，而且亲自干过这种事很多次，所以那种车头撞上人的感觉他很清楚，只是，他有些不明白，明明车头已经贴在了那个小子身上，但是却没有了下文，那种将人撞飞的快感根本就没传到彪子握住方向盘的双手中。

一群人围着本田商务车的车头，车灯照在车头前方的地上，那里，空荡荡的连个鬼影子都没有，但是坐在前排的野驴和彪子，明明都已经感觉到了车头撞在了那个男人身上，但是下了车却发现那个男人早就没有了影子。

野驴和彪子两个人对视了一眼，额头上同时冒出了一层豆大的汗珠，一阵夜晚的微风由巷子深处缓缓飘出来，更是让这哥俩的脊梁骨一阵阵的发寒，因为两个人似乎同一时间回想起了刚才的事情。

那个本应该被车撞飞的男人，似乎在那么一瞬间凭空消失在了车头前，是凭空消失，没有一丝的征兆，那个挺拔削瘦的背影就从他们两个人的注视中蒸发的干干净净！！

“不...不会是...见鬼了吧？”

彪子的声音有些颤抖，野驴的脸上更是一片煞白，在听到彪子说完这话之后更是腿一软，差一点坐在地上，做混混的虽然不怕警察，但却十分敬重鬼神，对于眼前这种邪门的事，再加上野驴平时就没做过什么好事，所以这个领着一票小弟的大哥，心中的恐惧比起其他小弟来讲，要多的多。

“啊！唔！...”就在野驴和彪子两个人准备拔腿开溜的时候，突然间巷子深处传来了一声让人毛骨悚然的尖叫声，而那尖叫声只是刚刚划破夜空，似乎就被什么东西给硬生生的掐断了，这声音，简直就是地狱使者的索命符，吓得彪子和野驴两个人噗通一声就坐在了地上。

而其他的小弟，虽然大部分也都是心生恐惧，但是也有人相对清醒，一直负责放风的耗子就是其中一个，这小子身高不足一米五，身形瘦的如同麻杆一样，虽然这小子身形矮小，但是身手却不错，上蹿下跳的事情最是拿手。

“驴哥，这声音...好像...好像是麻花那肥仔的...”耗子的声音虽然很突兀，但是却给了野驴和彪子一个提醒，两个人连忙从地上站起来，然后在人群里搜寻那个肉球一般的肥仔麻花！

但是，两个人的视线在四周扫了一圈，很清晰的没有发现那个平时最爱吃麻花的肥仔，这让这哥俩心头更是一阵阵的发寒。

“妈的，麻花那肥仔足有两百斤重，就这么悄无声息的从我们身边消失，我们这次，肯定是撞鬼了，哥几个，上车，赶紧撤，回去之后沐浴更衣，给我好好拜拜关二爷！！”野驴这次是真的怕了，急匆匆说完这句话之后第一个冲上了车，而且他人紧随其后，也紧跟着上了车。

“耗子，清点人数，彪子，给老子开车！”这鬼地方野驴是一秒钟都不想多呆下去了，上车之后马上吼出了命令。

“是，驴哥。”随着耗子开始清点人数，彪子也准备开车，但是，很快车内再度陷入了一片死寂，野驴更是面如死灰。

“驴哥...车钥匙没了。”彪子抬起头，双眼带着血丝，脸上，更是如同刚刚被雨淋完一般，湿漉漉的分不清是泪水还是汗水。

“驴哥...”耗子的声音也在此刻传来，野驴看着耗子脸上的恐惧，下意识的追问了一句“怎么回事？谁不在？”

耗子擦了擦额头的汗水，之后轻声回道“老二和草鸡”

野驴的恐惧进一步加剧，因为刚才他明明已经看到了老二和草鸡这两个没事就喜欢玩群P的淫*棍，但是现在，耗子却告诉他两个人不在车上，那他们去哪了？凭空消失？除了鬼，还有什么东西可以神不知鬼不觉的抓走他们！

事情的发展越来越邪门，野驴和彪子等人已经接近了崩溃边缘，而在不远处的阴影中，楚岩一脸微笑的看着这群混混，伸手提起了倒在自己一边的一团肉球...

“砰！”就在车内气氛几乎令人窒息的时候，忽然间车顶上传来了一声巨响，应该是什么重物砸在了车顶上，野驴等人疯了似地从车里冲了出来，然后几乎所有人的视线都落在了车顶上那个死神一般的身影上。

削瘦，挺拔的身影，手里，拎着一个不知道死活的肉球，野驴一眼便认出了车顶上的身影，正是他们想要撞飞的目标，楚岩，同时也认出了楚岩手里拎着的那团肉球，正是最早凭空消失的肉球麻花。

足足两百斤的肥仔，在楚岩手里似乎没什么重量，而楚岩在星光下的面孔，却是带着淡淡的微笑。

“说吧，他在哪？”楚岩说完，手里的肥仔如同破麻袋一般直接扔到了丰田商务车的前挡风玻璃上“砰！”挡风玻璃应声而碎，但是麻花的身体依然毫无反应，是死是活更是无从知晓。

“鬼啊！！”一声歇斯底里的嚎叫由野驴口中传出，紧接着一群混混疯了一样朝着四面八方冲了出去，速度之快，令人咂舌。

其实野驴能带着一票小弟，头脑还是有一点的，现在之所以吼这一嗓子，一是为了转移楚岩的注意力，二是为了逃命，自从楚岩开口说话的那一刻，这小子就已经知道自己所面对的，根本不是什么鬼，而是更可怕的、杀人不眨眼的人，麻花肯定已经死翘翘，如果他此刻不装作遇见鬼而逃命，恐怕这个人也不会放过自己。

野驴的算盘打的很是不错，可惜，当他已经冲出数百米然后气喘吁吁的停下来的时候，他的肩头上，却是悄无声息的出现了一只修长而有力的大手。

“他在哪？”声音虽然很低，但是却如同九天寒冰，野驴再想跑，却发现自己似乎被人捏住肩膀提了起来，两脚在空中蹬弹了半天，却没碰着地，惊恐之余，也只好放弃了反抗，他能感觉的出来，他的肩膀上，传到脑袋里的痛觉在一点点的增加着，一想到肥仔麻花两百斤都被眼前这个人当成破麻袋扔了出去，自己这不足一百斤的身体，还是老实一点的好。

“莲花俱乐部。”野驴如同倒豆子一般说出了一个地名，紧接着眼前一黑失去了知觉，楚岩将敲晕的野驴扔到了路边的一个垃圾桶里，之后走向了野驴他们开来的本田商务车。

莲花俱乐部，八八八号贵宾房，罗开那肥硕的身躯正半躺在按摩椅上，戴满了硕大金戒指的手上，还端着一杯红酒，在他身上，一袭薄纱的按摩技师正在卖力的工作着，出奇的是，这胖子是在享受真正的按摩，而不是一些特别服务，一张闪烁着油光的脸上，表情很是舒坦，也许，这小子还在做着美梦，一会能与某人共进晚餐然后再完成他的某些大计划呢。

只是，闭目享受的罗开却突然间感觉到了按摩技师的动作停了下来，当他睁开眼的时候，却发现眼前一片漆黑，贵宾房不知何时，居然停电了...
content_en:
"Brother Lu, this kid came out within five minutes of going in. What on earth was he doing? Did he go to call the police?" Biaozi, who was driving in the black business car, looked at Chu Yan who was leaving the building slowly. The cells in his head began to die in large areas. With his IQ, he couldn't guess what Chu Yan was doing in the place where all the gangsters least wanted to go.

"Why do you care so much? Just follow up and finish what Brother Kai told you." Wild Ass is obviously the leader of this group of gangsters, and his mind is full of dark thoughts. Now, he only thinks about what will happen after completing the tasks assigned by Luo Kai. Women, drugs, and alcohol are all things that fill Ye Donkey's daily life.

"Well, let's go." Biaozi nodded, no longer thinking about what Chu Yan was doing in that building, he started the car and slowly approached Chu Yan's back.

There were a total of thirteen people sitting in the car, filling the car to the brim. These people were all the younger brothers of Wild Ass. Their daily job was to fight, intimidate, and collect protection fees. They were somewhat well-known in the Xijiucheng District of Nanshan City. Of course, they were limited to the lowest level of gangsters.

The black business car was getting closer and closer to Chu Yan, but Chu Yan was still walking leisurely. In the distance, there was an alley. There were only three or two street lights left in the alley that flickered on and off.

Suddenly, the commercial vehicle suddenly accelerated its speed, Biaozi stepped on the accelerator, and the commercial vehicle rushed straight towards Chu Yan like a wild horse!

"Squeak!!" The screeching sound of the brakes was particularly creepy in the night sky. In the distance, several rooms that had lights on originally simply turned off their lights. This year, no one wants to join in the fun in the middle of the night. If they are not careful, they will get into trouble.

"Did we hit it?" The wild donkey was the first to open the car door and rush out, followed closely by the other gangsters. This was not the first time they had done this kind of thing. They were familiar with the road and didn't worry about hitting someone to death. They were just gangsters, not at the level where they had the guts to kill anyone, but they had done this to cripple someone countless times.

"Brother Lu, okay...it doesn't seem to have hit..." Biaozi was the last one to get out of the car, because he was the driver and had done this kind of thing many times, so he knew the feeling of the front of the car hitting someone. However, he didn't understand. It was obvious that the front of the car had been attached to the kid, but there was no follow-up. The pleasure of knocking the person away did not reach Biaozi's hands holding the steering wheel at all.

A group of people gathered around the front of the Honda commercial vehicle. The lights shone on the ground in front of the car. There was no sign of a ghost there. However, the wild donkey and Biaozi sitting in the front row had clearly felt the front of the car hit the man. However, when they got out of the car, they found that the man had long since disappeared.

Wild Donkey and Biaozi looked at each other, with large beads of sweat appearing on their foreheads at the same time. A night breeze slowly drifted out from the depths of the alley, sending chills down the spines of the two brothers, because they seemed to recall what had just happened at the same time.

The man who should have been hit by the car seemed to disappear in front of the car in an instant. He disappeared out of thin air without any warning. The tall and thin back evaporated completely from the gazes of the two of them!!

"No...it can't be...a ghost, right?"

Biaozi's voice was trembling, and Wild Donkey's face turned pale. After hearing what Biaozi said, his legs went weak and he almost sat on the ground. Although gangsters are not afraid of the police, they respect ghosts and gods very much. Regarding such evil things in front of them, and Wild Donkey has never done anything good, so the eldest brother who leads a group of younger brothers has much more fear in his heart than the other younger brothers.

"Ah! Hmm!..." Just when Wild Donkey and Biaozi were about to run away, suddenly a blood-curdling scream came from deep in the alley, and the scream just cut through the night sky, and seemed to be cut off by something. This sound was simply the life-killing talisman of the messenger from hell, and Biaozi and Wild Donkey sat down on the ground with a puff in fear.

Although most of the other boys are afraid, there are some who are relatively sober. One of them is the rat who has been responsible for the release. This boy is less than 1.5 meters tall and as thin as a hemp pole. Although this boy is short in stature, he has good skills and is best at jumping up and down.

"Brother Donkey, this voice... sounds like... it seems to belong to that fat boy, Ma Hua..." Although the rat's voice was very abrupt, it gave Wild Donkey and Biaozi a reminder. The two people quickly stood up from the ground, and then searched the crowd for the fat boy, Ma Hua!

However, the two people scanned the surroundings and clearly did not find the fat boy who usually loved to eat mahua. This made the two brothers feel even more chilled.

"Damn, that fat boy from Ma Hua weighed two hundred kilograms. He just disappeared from us so quietly. We must have hit a ghost this time. Brothers, get in the car and get out quickly. After you get back, take a shower and change clothes. Pay my respects to Mr. Guan!!" The wild donkey was really scared this time. After saying this in a hurry, he was the first to rush into the car, and others followed closely behind.

"Mouse, count the number of people, Biaozi, drive for me!" The wild donkey didn't want to stay in this ghost place for a second longer, and immediately shouted the order after getting in the car.

"Yes, Brother Donkey." As Mouse began to count the number of people, Biaozi also prepared to drive, but soon the car fell into dead silence again, and Wild Donkey's face turned ashen.

"Brother Lu...the car key is gone." Biaozi raised his head, his eyes were bloodshot, and his face looked as if it had just been soaked by the rain. It was so wet that it was hard to tell whether it was tears or sweat.

"Brother Donkey..." The mouse's voice also came at this moment. The wild donkey looked at the fear on the mouse's face and subconsciously asked, "What's going on? Who's not here?"

Mouse wiped the sweat from his forehead, and then softly replied, "Lao Er and grass chicken."

The wild donkey's fear was further intensified, because just now he had clearly seen Lao Er and Cao Ji, two sluts who liked to have sex with each other when they had nothing to do. But now, the mouse told him that the two of them were not in the car, so where were they?Disappear into thin air?Besides ghosts, what else can capture them without anyone noticing!

The development of things is getting more and more evil. Ye Lu, Biao Zi and others are close to the edge of collapse. In the shadow not far away, Chu Yan looks at these gangsters with a smile on his face, reaches out and lifts a ball of meat that fell on his side...

"Bang!" Just when the atmosphere in the car was almost suffocating, suddenly there was a loud noise on the roof of the car. It should be that something heavy hit the roof of the car. Wild Donkey and others rushed out of the car like crazy, and then almost everyone's eyes fell on the death-like figure on the roof of the car.

The thin, tall figure was holding an unknown meat ball in his hand. The wild donkey recognized the figure on the roof of the car at a glance. It was the target they wanted to knock away, Chu Yan. At the same time, he also recognized the ball of meat in Chu Yan's hand. It was the earliest meat ball twist that disappeared out of thin air.

The fat boy, who weighed two hundred kilograms, seemed to weigh nothing in Chu Yan's hands, but Chu Yan's face under the starlight had a faint smile.

"Tell me, where is he?" After Chu Yan finished speaking, the fat boy in his hand was thrown directly onto the front windshield of the Toyota commercial vehicle like a broken sack. "Bang!" The windshield shattered with a sound, but Ma Hua's body was still unresponsive, and it was impossible to know whether he was dead or alive.

"Ghost!!" A hysterical howl came from the mouth of the wild donkey, and then a group of gangsters rushed out in all directions like crazy, the speed was staggering.

In fact, the wild donkey can lead a group of young men, and he still has some brains. The reason why he is roaring now is to divert Chu Yan's attention, and to escape for his life. From the moment Chu Yan opened his mouth to speak, this boy already knew that what he was facing was not a ghost at all, but a more terrifying person who killed without blinking an eye. Ma Hua must be dead. If he didn't pretend to meet a ghost and run for his life, I'm afraid this person would not let him go.

The wild donkey's abacus was very good, but unfortunately, when he had rushed hundreds of meters and stopped panting, a long, slender and powerful hand appeared silently on his shoulder.

"Where is he?" Although the voice was very low, it was like nine days of ice. The wild donkey wanted to run again, but found that he seemed to be picked up by his shoulders. His feet bounced in the air for a long time, but did not touch the ground. In fear, he had to give up resistance.He could feel that the pain on his shoulder that was transmitted to his head was increasing little by little. When he thought of Fatty Twist's two hundred kilograms being thrown out as a broken sack by the man in front of him, he had better be honest with his body of less than one hundred kilograms.

"Lotus Club." Ye Donkey said a place name like pouring beans, and then his vision went dark and he lost consciousness. Chu Yan threw the knocked out Ye Donkey into a trash can on the roadside, and then walked towards the Honda commercial vehicle that Ye Donkey and the others drove.

Lotus Club, VIP Room No. 888, Luo Kai's plump body is half lying on the massage chair, his hand covered with huge gold rings is holding a glass of red wine. On his body, a massage technician dressed in tulle is working hard. Surprisingly,, this fat man is enjoying a real massage, not some special service, with a shiny face, and a very comfortable expression. Maybe, this kid is still dreaming about having dinner with someone and then completing some of his big plans.

However, Luo Kai, who was enjoying himself with his eyes closed, suddenly felt the massage technician's movements stop. When he opened his eyes, he found that everything in front of him was pitch black, and the power in the VIP room had stopped at some point...
